anomalies.description: A vehicle on the right shoulder loses control, spins sideways, and slides across the road while emitting a large plume of smoke/dust, indicating a crash or severe skid.

A black sedan in front of the dashcam vehicle swerves sharply to the left, crossing the center line and colliding with an oncoming vehicle (partially visible), causing a visible impact and displacement of the black car.

After the collision, a small animal (likely a fox or similar canid) is seen lying motionless on the road shoulder near the point of impact; the black sedan continues driving away without stopping, leaving the injured/possibly deceased animal unattended.

A light-colored sedan is struck from the side by an unseen vehicle, causing it to rotate rapidly and slide across the road during heavy rain; visible impact and loss of control occur within this interval.

A second collision occurs: a dark object (likely a vehicle or large debris) impacts the right side of the recording vehicle, causing violent camera shake and windshield distortion; debris and spray are visible in frames f5–f8.
A person is struck by the vehicle and falls onto the hood/windshield, visible as a dark figure impacting the front of the car between frames f5 and f7.

A person wearing red appears on the hood/windshield of the recording vehicle at t=59.0 (f14), suggesting they were ejected or thrown onto the car during or after the prior impact; remains visible through f15.; A vehicle (likely a car) is struck by a large object or debris from the right side during heavy rain, causing violent impact and spray obscuring the windshield; visible as sudden lateral displacement and massive water/debris splash in frames f0–f3.

A motorcycle rider ahead loses control on a dirt path, falls to the left side, and slides across the ground; the following motorcycle (camera vehicle) swerves sharply to avoid collision, with visible leg/foot of fallen rider entering frame at f14–f15.
